# Mipon

> > Mipon is your guide to anime tourism in Japan, featuring real-life anime locations, otaku events, and exclusive creator interviews.

Mipon specializes in anime pilgrimage guides across Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, and other Japanese cities, helping fans discover the real-world locations from beloved series like Your Name, Sword Art Online, Fate/Zero, and more. The site also covers major anime events like Wonder Festival and World Cosplay Summit, alongside interviews with mangaka and voice actors.

## Key Topics

- Anime pilgrimage and real-life locations
- Tokyo anime tourism (Akihabara, Nakano, Setagaya)
- Your Name and Weathering with You
- Makoto Shinkai films and cameos
- Wonder Festival and World Cosplay Summit
- Sword Art Online locations
- Fate series pilgrimage sites
- Dragon Ball and Attack on Titan attractions
- Manga and anime creator interviews
- Otaku culture and merchandise
- Japan anime events and conventions
- VR anime experiences
- Character crossovers and easter eggs
- Anime rankings and trends in Japan

## Anime Pilgrimage Guides

- [11 Sword Art Online (SAO) Real-Life Locations Tokyo](https://mipon.org/sword-art-online-pilgrimage): Guide to 11 SAO real-life locations in Tokyo including Imperial Palace
- [Fate/Zero Real Life Locations (Tokyo)](https://mipon.org/fate-series-pilgrimage-nakano): Fate/Zero pilgrimage guide featuring Tohsaka Rin's route in Nakano Broadway
- [5 Real Life Locations of The Irregular at Magic High School in Japan](https://mipon.org/mahouka-real-life-locations-japan): Pilgrimage guide to 5 Mahouka real-life locations in Tokyo
- [Visit the Building Where Saitama from One Punch Man Lives](https://mipon.org/one-punch-man-pilgrimage): One Punch Man pilgrimage to Saitama's apartment in Setagaya, Tokyo

## Makoto Shinkai Universe

- [Did Taki and Mitsuha appear in Weathering with You?](https://mipon.org/weathering-with-you-your-name-cameo): Explores Taki and Mitsuha's cameo appearances in Weathering with You
- [Weathering With You: Cameos Explained (Yotsuha, Yukari, Aqua, Pretty Cure and more!)](https://mipon.org/tenki-no-ko-your-name-connection-explained): Detailed analysis of Makoto Shinkai's Weathering with You cameos & easter eggs

## Events and Conventions

- [Wonder Festival 2025 - A Complete Guide on Tokyo's Figure Expo](https://mipon.org/wonder-festival-this-year): Complete guide to Wonder Festival 2025 at Makuhari Messe Tokyo
- [World Cosplay Summit Tokyo [2025 Guide]](https://mipon.org/world-cosplay-summit-tokyo-this-year): 2025 guide to World Cosplay Summit at Tokyo Dome and Nagoya events

## Creator Interviews

- [Where and How To Publish Your Own MANGA? | Interview with a PROFESSIONAL Mangaka](https://mipon.org/how-to-publish-manga-japan-interview-manga-creator): Mangaka Ryo Katagiri on publishing manga with Shogakukan and Weekly Shonen Sunday
- [Ascendance of a Bookworm: Interview with the AUTHOR Miya Kazuki](https://mipon.org/ascendance-of-a-bookworm-interview-author): Exclusive interview with Ascendance of a Bookworm author Miya Kazuki
- [Muro Tsuyoshi Interview: Space Academy & More](https://mipon.org/muro-tsuyoshi-interview): Interview with actor Muro Tsuyoshi on Space Academy voice acting

## Attractions and Experiences

- [Shingeki No Kyojin in Japan [Attractions, Figures & More]](https://mipon.org/shingeki-no-kyojin-japan): Attack on Titan attractions, VR games, and merchandise in Japan
- [The Best 4 Anime VR Attractions in Japan](https://mipon.org/anime-vr-games): Top anime VR experiences including Dragon Ball and Evangelion attractions
- [Evangelion Store in Fuji Q Highland](https://mipon.org/evangelion-world-fuji-q): Evangelion World merchandise store at Fuji Q Highland theme park
- [Captain Tsubasa Themed Restaurant in Tokyo, decorated by Yoichi Takahashi](https://mipon.org/captain-tsubasa-themed-restaurant): Captain Tsubasa Trattoria Avere restaurant in Katsushika by Yoichi Takahashi
- [Discover Akihabara with the Best Anime Online Tour](https://mipon.org/akihabara-anime-online-tour): Virtual tour experience of Akihabara's otaku culture and anime shops

## Anime Analysis and Trends

- [Which Anime Was Popular in Japan? (2020)](https://mipon.org/anime-popular-japan-2020): 2020 trending anime in Japan featuring Haikyu!! and AniKore rankings
- [Is Goku's Origin a Retcon in Dragon Ball Super?](https://mipon.org/origin-goku): Analysis of Goku's origin changes in Dragon Ball Super: Broly by Toriyama
